Key integer: (4+127)*(6+69)%70001+513 = 10338; MD5 of ASCII 10338 yields key a2cdd86a458242d42a17c2bf4feff069; IV is 16 zero bytes. Hex inputs are concatenated in vendor_ref, cache_seed, probe_salt order, then decrypted and gunzipped.

Decoded stage constructs curl, xattr, chmod, URLs and hidden /tmp paths through printf octal escapes. It downloads from https://draft-loop.com/f/qus5n9iecneukfdd5bqagg/8d5wkyb6, moves the temporary output, clears all extended attributes, sets +x, and launches the same destination.

Background POSTs report pasted and stager events to https://stratos30.com/api/metrics/run with user and BuildID headers. RAM, epoch, uid and username queries are assigned but not sent by the observed code; no credential theft or persistence is demonstrated.
printf produces a literal $$ in the temporary name; expansion is not recursively evaluated into a PID.
The downloaded final payload was not recovered or executed; its identity and runtime outcome remain unknown. Static delivery, concealment and activation suffice for the verdict.
